text:
sara: quick notes from tonight's chunked-handoff speculative run on specter-14b-q5 (new quant profile q5_mixed). strategy: predictor is mini-guide-2b-fp16 (greedy) producing short chunked fast-paths; verifier glues chunks on specter-14b-q5. saw ~2.15x token throughput and p50 latency ~1.8x improvement on chat microbench.

lee: chunked-handoff? walk me through the flow briefly.

sara: predictor proposes next-chunk (<=32 tokens). runtime concatenates predictor chunks until verifier decides to validate or runs out of budget. verifier runs on specter-14b-q5 with early_abort=0.07. kv_prefetch=true. idea is to amortize big-model calls on long outputs.

priya: interesting. what tasks + holdouts?

sara: tasks: longform-summarization (news-articles-v1, 1.2k ex), multi-doc-rerank (rank-mini-v2). metrics: ROUGE-L, BERTScore-F1 for summarization; rerank MRR@10 for ranking.

lee: numbers? any quality deltas?

sara: summarization ROUGE-L down ~1.4 pts aggregate, BERTScore -0.9. rerank MRR stable within noise. breakdown: regressions concentrated on extreme-long articles (>1200 tokens) where chunk boundary alignment caused minor coherence drops.

priya: can you paste the eval command so I can repro locally?

sara: sure:

```
./eval_harness \
  --predictor=mini-guide-2b-fp16 \
  --verifier=specter-14b-q5 \
  --spec_mode=chunked_handoff \
  --chunk_max=32 \
  --early_abort=0.07 \
  --kv_prefetch=true \
  --tasks=longform-summarization,multi-doc-rerank \
  --holdouts=news-articles-v1,rank-mini-v2 \
  --batch=6 \
  --seed=2026
```

bench-bot: perf job 7503221001 completed - artifacts: /artifacts/7503221001/metrics.json - logs: https://ci/internal/arty/7503221001

lee: chunk alignment sounds like a red flag. did you log per-chunk accept_rate and boundary_mismatch_rate?

sara: yes: accept_rate overall 70%. boundary_mismatch_rate (cases where final output had a coherence break at chunk boundary) ~2.6% for long docs, ~0.4% short docs. when we forced chunk_max=16 accept_rate improved to 77% but throughput dropped to ~1.7x.

priya: what about verifier calibration? cross-model scoring could mis-evaluate glued chunks. any logit-scaling tried?

sara: not yet for this run. hypothesis: quantized verifier scores skew confidence for glued sequences. will try per-chunk calibration and an ensemble verifier on a dev slice.

lee: please also run paired-bootstrap on ROUGE-L for long-doc cohort to check significance. if p<0.05 we need mitigation before rollout.

sara: queued paired-bootstrap job 7503222002 for long-doc ROUGE-L (n=1000).

ops-bot: telemetry update: added metrics `chunk_accept_rate_by_doc_len`, `boundary_mismatch_rate_by_bin`, `verifier_confidence_raw`, and `predictor_chunk_entropy`. These will be available in nightly runs.

priya: mitigation ideas?

sara: options: (1) reduce chunk_max for long docs, (2) increase verifier conservatism for chunk boundaries (lower early_abort), (3) run a lightweight consistency pass that asks predictor to re-expand last chunk if low entropy, (4) route longform->no-spec for docs >1600 tokens.

lee: I'm partial to (3) as low-cost: if predictor_chunk_entropy < threshold -> auto-expand last chunk and re-verify. add a small threshold sweep.

sara: will implement entropy-based expansion and sweep chunk_max in [16,24,32] and early_abort [0.04,0.07,0.12]. will push branch `exp/chunk-handoff-specter-750321` and report results.

priya: thanks. also collect top-50 regressed summaries for manual triage; I'll review language drift vs factual omissions.

sara: done, uploaded triage set to /experiments/chunk-handoff-specter-750321/regressions.json. will follow up after bootstrap. :satellite:
